title: Runner observability terminal-safe three-file proof
objective: Create a small typed gauge dependency chain whose three isolated File Jobs validate the final terminal-safe Runner live feed.
requirements: Gauge records expose label, amount, suffix, and featured fields with the exact planned types.
formatGauge emits the gauge label, a colon, its numeric amount, and its suffix with stable spacing.

owns.name: Gauge
owns.description: Describes one gauge and whether it belongs in the featured summary.
owns.declaration: export interface Gauge { label: string; amount: number; suffix: string; featured: boolean; }

context.purpose: Defines the gauge vocabulary and summary behavior.

skills.name: Minimal gauge contract
skills.content: Export exactly the planned Gauge interface. Keep every property required and add no runtime behavior or extra exports.

constraints: Do not add declarations beyond Gauge.

files.task: Format one gauge with stable punctuation and spacing.
requirements: formatGauge emits the gauge label, a colon, its numeric amount, and its suffix with stable spacing.

owns.name: formatGauge
owns.description: Formats one gauge label, numeric amount, and suffix for display.

context.purpose: Defines the exact gauge label behavior.

skills.name: NodeNext gauge formatter
skills.content: Use an import type for Gauge and the exact NodeNext-relative module specifier supplied in the Agent Input. Return the label, colon, amount, and suffix without mutating the gauge.

files.task: Compose the featured-gauge summary from the shared formatter.
requirements: summarizeGauges preserves input order, includes only featured gauges, reports the featured count, and returns No featured gauges when none qualify.

owns.name: summarizeGauges
owns.description: Builds the ordered human-readable summary of featured gauges.
owns.declaration: export function summarizeGauges(gauges: readonly Gauge[]): string;

context.purpose: Defines filtering, ordering, header, and empty behavior.

skills.name: Stable gauge summary
skills.content: Filter without sorting or mutating. For one featured gauge use `1 featured gauge`; otherwise use `{count} featured gauges`. Put each formatted gauge on its own following line. Return exactly `No featured gauges` when the filtered list is empty.

constraints: Call formatGauge(gauge) for each featured gauge.
